text:
elena: Quick ask — can we approve a temporary volume discount + onboarding fee waiver for KiteHealth?
They're running a 3-month paid pilot across 3 hospitals. Sales ask: 35% off token charges for the first 3 months + waive the $8k onboarding fee.
Quote: <https://app.redwood/quotes/KITE-420>
Need sign-off by EOD Friday to lock capacity and pricing.

matt: Can you drop the expected spend numbers? baseline vs discounted and total pilot value pls.

elena: Sure — quick numbers below (rounded):
```
Baseline token revenue (no discount): $14,600/mo (month1 heavy), months 2-3 ~ $6,000/mo
35% discount -> month1 becomes ~$9,500, months2-3 ~$3,900/mo
Total 3-mo gross ~ $26,600 -> net after discount ~ $17,300 + onboarding waived ($8k)
```
Reason: strategic healthcare ref account, strong chance to convert Dedicated after pilot.

sam: 35% is above our standard pilot concession (usually 15–20%). We need deal-desk approval and a revenue impact calc. Also want a minimum commitment (even for pilot) — otherwise parity with other pilot concessions.

jordan: From AE POV — high likelihood to expand (they asked about Dedicated in demo). If we add a conversion credit (credit onboarding if they convert within 6mo) it de-risks the waiver. Sales will push for it.

priya: Legal: fine in principle for a time-limited pilot. Will require: (1) explicit pilot term 90 days, (2) clause that discount applies only to pilot usage, (3) data-handling & PHI note (they're healthcare). I can draft an addendum.

revenue-bot: Approval request created: AP-2026-118 — https://internal.redwood/approvals/AP-2026-118 (status: pending finance review) :receipt: 

matt: Finance pre-approve conditional on: (a) limit discount to exactly 90 days, (b) min aggregated pilot spend $15k across 3 months, (c) SOC2/PHI controls confirmed by Legal. If those hold, +1 from finance.

elena: Got it — updated quote: <https://app.redwood/quotes/KITE-420?rev=2> with 90-day discount and conversion credit clause. Priya, assigning draft addendum to you.

priya: I'll push the addendum today, will include PHI handling & one-way conversion credit.

jordan: :thumbsup: I'll loop in the AE and customer success to get signatures.

elena: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the trail. Will mark approval final once AP-2026-118 flips to approved.

matt: tagging for visibility @sam — once legal ok, I'll sign off in the approval portal.

sam: noted. If AP clears, finance will route for billing code updates so we don't overbill during pilot.

elena: Excellent. Appreciate fast turn.
